results.text: "Only if you can produce proof that the light beneath that door has a purpose beyond decoration. I don't have a budget for nothing."
"Rent? You mean for a space you haven't even entered, sir?" I adjust my uniform, eyes fixed on the rain-streaked glass. "There's no invoice, and there's no lease to break up, let alone pay off."

results.utterance: What is behind the locked office door?
results.text: "That's just a trick of the lamplight, sir."
